verdict.rationale: Gumloop publishes its own API reference with per-endpoint pages (create agent, create session, authentication) and SDK docs, so a browsable reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
